notes.title: 🎉 LAUNCH ANNOUNCEMENT 🎉
notes.content: [p][b] 🚀 **THE PUZZLE ADVENTURE BEGINS!**[/b][/p][p]We're thrilled to announce the official launch of [b]**Giantess Girls! Job Jigsaw Jamboree**[/b] - an immersive puzzle game that combines challenging jigsaw mechanics with rewarding progression and stunning visual content![/p][p]---[/p][p][b]🎯 **What Makes This Game Special?**[/b][/p][p][b] 🧩 **Massive Puzzle Collection**[/b][/p][p]- [b]**35 Unique Puzzles**[/b] - 32 main challenges plus 3 exclusive bonus puzzles[/p][p]- [b]**Progressive Difficulty**[/b] - Start with relaxing 3x3 grids and work up to mind-bending 10x10 challenges[/p][p]- [b]**Beautiful Artwork**[/b] - Each puzzle features stunning, high-quality imagery[/p][p]- [b]**Varied Themes**[/b] - Diverse content ensuring every puzzle feels fresh and exciting[/p]
